## Description

Found 13 Nov 2026 while seeding the Azure dev load practice (MDV-P1-037). The dev workspace `log-medvya-dev-*` has a 0.2 GB daily cap and is OverQuota most days, so every log after the cap (App Insights traces and requests, Container Apps job logs, alerts that read them) is dropped until the 12:00 UTC reset. Ingestion: about 224 MB on 11 Nov and 354 MB on 12 Nov in AzureDiagnostics alone, almost all `PostgreSQLLogs`: on 12 Nov about 110k pgaudit SESSION READ lines, 86k WRITE, 8k DDL and 14k connection/disconnection lines. The server parameter `pgaudit.log` reads `write, ddl, role` (read was turned off on 7 Nov), so find what still enables READ (a role- or database-level `pgaudit.log` setting, or a session setting) and remove it. Then keep PostgreSQL diagnostics from starving the application: send only the categories needed (or route PostgreSQL logs to their own table, plan or storage), and size the cap so a normal day plus a seed or load run stays under it. Two WRITE audit lines on 12 Nov held literal VALUES: check they carry no patient values (dev is synthetic, but the pilot will not be).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a normal day on Azure dev, when the Usage table is read, then ingestion stays under the daily cap and the workspace is never OverQuota.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a database session as the app role, when it runs a SELECT, then no pgaudit READ line is written.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a Container Apps job run (db migrate or seed) at any hour, when it finishes, then its console log is in Log Analytics.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given pgaudit WRITE lines, when they are sampled, then none holds a parameter value (log_parameter off and no literal patient values).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
